summary: Added a `show_speed` parameter (default False) to `TaskProgressColumn` in rich/progress.py. When the task total is unknown and show_speed is on, the column renders task.speed as "{speed:.2f} it/s", falling back to text_format_no_percentage while speed is unknown. Added a constructor docstring. Not run or tested, per instructions; no commit made. Docs and CHANGELOG were not updated.
